data.heading: Food chain
data.rubric: Click on each image to know how energy passes from one organism to another.
data.text: Animals need energy so they can do all the things that they do.
The source of all energy on Earth is the Sun.
Energy from the Sun passes from one living thing to another through a food chain.
A food chain tells us how energy is transferred from one organism to another through food.
The Sun provides heat and light to all living things.
Plants use sunlight, water, chlorophyll, and minerals from the ground to make their own energy. Plants are known as producers.
Some animals get their energy directly by eating plants. They are known as primary consumers.
Some animals get their energy from animals that eat plants. They are known as secondary consumers.
Some animals get their energy by consuming secondary consumers. They are known as tertiary consumers.
All producers and consumers after they die decompose to become nutrients that can be used by plants.
